name: PD 349 was established by Ordinance No. 20923, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 10,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 349 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 349 was established by Ordinance No. 20923, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 10, 1991. Ordinance No. 20923 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 20923 was amended by Ordinance No. 22060, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 25, 1994; Ordinance No. 23571, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 24, 1998; and Ordinance No. 24786, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 12, 2001. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20923; 22060; 23571; 24786; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 349 is established on property generally located at the northeast, northwest, and southeast corners of the intersection of Columbia Avenue and Augusta Street. The size of PD 349 is approximately 29,338.6 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20923; 22060; 23571; 24786; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 349A).

(b) An additional development plan was approved by Ordinance No. 24786 for Tract 3 (Exhibit 349B). (Ord. Nos. 22060; 24786; 25850)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.105. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 349C). All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. [Note: Exhibit 349A, which replaced the development plan attached to Ord. No. 20923, includes landscaping.] (Ord. Nos. 20923; 22060; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.106. USES.

(a) Tract 1. The only uses permitted on Tract 1 of the Property are art gallery uses, surface parking, and warehouse uses.

(b) Tract 2. The only uses permitted on Tract 2 of the Property are art gallery uses and office uses.

(c) Tract 3. The only uses permitted on Tract 3 of the Property are art gallery uses and duplex uses.

(d) Art gallery defined. For purposes of this article, “art gallery” means an establishment for the creation and/or display of objects of art. (Ord. Nos. 23571; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.107. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

(a) Setbacks. Setbacks for all structures on the Property must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(b) Maximum floor area. Maximum floor area on the Property is 4,825 square feet for office uses, 7,294 square feet for art gallery uses, and 1,350 square feet for indoor storage space. Floor area for all uses on Tract 1 may not exceed 1,350 square feet. Floor area for all uses on Tract 2 may not exceed 5,694 square feet. Floor area for all uses on Tract 3 may not exceed 1,600 square feet. Floor area ratio for all uses on Tract 2 may not exceed 0.6. Floor area ratio for all uses on Tract 3 may not exceed 0.6.

(c) Maximum lot coverage. Maximum permitted lot coverage on Tract 2 is 30 percent. Maximum permitted lot coverage on Tract 3 is 50 percent.

(d) Maximum height and stories. Maximum height on Tracts 1 and 2 is 30 feet. Maximum number of stories on Tract 1 is one. Maximum number of stories on Tract 2 is two. Maximum number of stories on Tract 3 is one with a mezzanine. Maximum height on Tract 3 is 18 feet. (Ord. Nos. 23571; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.108. OFF-STREET PARKING.

A minimum of 17 off-street parking spaces must be provided as shown on the development plans for Tracts 1 and 2. No fewer than one parking space must be provided on Tract 3, as shown on the development plan for Tract 3. An additional 14 spaces must be provided within 300 feet from Tract 3 pursuant to a special parking agreement. The requirement contained in Division 51A-4.320, “Special Parking Regulations,” which limits the amount of special parking for a use to 50 percent of the use’s parking requirement is hereby waived. (Ord. Nos. 23571; 25850)

sections.title: Historic Landmark Criteria
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.109. HISTORIC LANDMARK CRITERIA.

For additional regulations applicable to Tract 2, see the historic landmark criteria governing the Property, which are contained in Ordinance No. 20055, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 24, 1988. (Ord. Nos. 22060; 25850)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.110. MAINTENANCE.

The entire premises must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance. (Ord. Nos. 22060; 25850)

sections.title: Hours Of Operation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.111. HOURS OF OPERATION.

The hours of operation for Tract 3 are limited to the hours between 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. (Ord. Nos. 23571; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.112. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in the PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22060; 24786; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-349.113. ZONING MAP.

PD 349 is located on Zoning Map No. I-8. (Ord. Nos. 20923; 25850)
